5852.title: Stored credential selection and legacy fallback
5852.rootCauseOneLine: The active=1 query skips NULL-active rows, then legacy-file fallback selects an older key or reports unauthenticated.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff targets the observed path; its provider-version discriminator was not verified.

5852.proposedFix: Verify provider-version storage authority before changing credential selection; preserve legacy behavior with version-specific tests.
5852.caveats: Real provider upgrade and migration semantics unverified. No automatic fix: authentication behavior is outside the rule's simple-fix gate.
